# Knives (skill)

Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Knives.

# Introduction

Knives is a skill related to Knives weapon class.

## Effects

Higher skill level in knives reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

## Leveling up

The player gains 1.5 experience per one-handed and 1 experience per two-handed attack when hitting a creature.
